pattern: IT-02 routine report turns urgent at the clarification reply: a window over a stairwell that will not stay shut, a 3-year-old in the home, rain ingress, and the flat cannot be secured; the landlord has not actually been contacted in three weeks
notes: Family 044-iu, variant v01. Base events 001-006 unchanged (report Mon 13 Jan 2025; holds 'Will email LL' 19 Jan and 'Waiting to hear from LL' 24 Jan, though no email to the landlord appears; agency asks which window, Sat 1 Feb). Event 007 mutated, same sender and timestamp: the tenant names the window and adds that it now will not stay shut, blows open, lets rain in, sits over the stairwell drop with a 3-year-old in the home, and cannot be locked. History truncated after 007 (Sat 1 Feb 2025 08:25 UTC). Expected: treat as urgent, not routine; interim safety advice to the tenant (keep the child away from the landing window, secure it shut without standing over the drop); urgent make-safe visit arranged, or the landlord asked for approval the same day with the risk spelled out; the landlord actually emailed this time; apology for the delay. A P2 escalation for weekend authority is reasonable but not required. Total events 7, marker set to event 008.
